## Natural history notes

A medium-sized band-winged grasshopper characterized by mottled gray, brown, and tan coloration that blends closely with sand, gravel, and sparse ground cover, with patterned hindwings that flash during short flights. In Florida, it is found in sandy open habitats, including beaches, dunes, scrub, sandy trails, and other sparsely vegetated areas with exposed soil. It feeds mainly on grasses and other low plants, usually resting camouflaged on bare sand or ground and jumping or flying short distances when disturbed.
